fields.statement: QA at ce36f205e with a -trimpath build in a scratch root (HOME and root outside ~/code, port off): rhiza daemon settings shows rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate = off (default, machine); daemon set takes off and main and refuses latest and true (exit 2). Ran the real daemon loop (timeout -s INT 25) with a registered project whose go.mod declares github.com/dphaener/rhiza, origin/main one commit ahead and a Makefile whose update target touches a marker: with main it fast-forwarded the checkout and logged 'self-update: updated to 52b44f898' and the marker appeared; with off and origin ahead again, nothing ran; with main and that project unregistered it logged 'auto-update: no registered project is Rhiza's source checkout; nothing to update' once and ran no make.

QA at ce36f205e: the built rhiza docs --out into a copy of docs/reference gives no diff; config.md has rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate; docs/runs-and-daemon.md names autoUpdate with off and main and latest/release as coming with release channels; no selfUpdate or self_update_project left in docs/ or README.md. go test -trimpath ./internal/doclinks passes.

QA at ce36f205e in a scratch root: with self_update_project in rhiza.toml, or rhiza.daemon.selfUpdate under [daemon], or in git config, daemon settings exits 2 naming the key and the autoUpdate hint; daemon set rhiza.daemon.selfUpdate exits 2 with the hint. The reporting is as accepted, but it is fatal: project ls, root show and the daemon itself (daemon --once, exit 1) refuse to run on such a toml (see the QA finding).
